book.name: 1 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Saaka wù le lɛ ba gɛ̀ ta Kletu yi kintaaŋ le
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bɛŋ kwâjɛ sege ŋgɛ̀ nto fɛ bɛŋ le ki nfejɛ saaka wù Nyo bɛŋ le wù gɛ̀ shee wu nyume nyilɛ le. Ŋgɛ̀ mbaaŋ nto gɛ fiaŋ ki nfêjɛ bɛ jɛ yi yege kɛnɛ bvufee bwaŋ gɛ,
nje ŋgɛ̀ faŋ lo sege ŋgɛ̀ bee a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ lɛ gɛ mɛ nyume ŋgɛ̂ɛ bvufee yi fiɛɛ fimi le gɛ fede ki nfêeji gɛ nyume kune Jiso Kletu maa, fede munchii, no ba gɛ̀ ta wu yi kintaaŋ le.
No ŋgɛ̀ bee besabɛŋ, ŋgɛ̀ wɛɛyi lo, nfaane wesee, ŋkoge.
Sege ŋgɛ̀ njɛme nfeeji saaka wù joŋe bɛŋ le, ŋgɛ̀ mbaaŋ njɛme gɛ nyu bɛ jɛ́ yi bvufee yi yege gɛ. Ŋgɛ̀ njɛme no bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Yuude nduunyi.
Ŋgɛ̀ gee noo, wu lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ lêesɛ fitele yi bvufee bvu muh wu wuŋ le gɛ, geenɛ lɛ bɛŋ lêesɛ nyume yi bvuŋga bvu Nyo le.

Bamii ba lɛme wa bɛ Nyo bo tɛɛme, bee to be nyaa bvufee bo le. Gɛ bvufee bvunɛ nyume bvu fɛkuu fɛnɛ kɛnɛ mo bvu yɛɛŋ wù sage fɛkuu fɛnɛ mɛɛse. Bobaa le bamii ba bvuŋga bvuboo lé bvu gê bvu lɛ̂sɛ achiji.
Bvufee bvu Nyo bvu baaŋ bvù bee feeji bvunɛ le fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ shee fi nyume nyilɛ le bamii kee gɛ. Bvufee bvuyu gɛ̀ seese Nyo baaŋ lo fɛ woŋ kɛ, ki fi yû fi tô bɛ bvukugɛ fɛ besabɛŋ le.
Gɛ bvufee bvunɛ nyu muh mu ŋgoo yi bamii ba sage kife kinɛ le, gɛ bo kee kinyi kiyu gɛ, nje gɛ̀ bee bo kee tu bo gɛ̀ baaŋ ta gɛ Tada wù kɛme bvukugɛ bvuchii yi kintaaŋ le gɛ.
Geenɛ, fɛ besabɛŋ le no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Mwɛɛ mù ajii gɛ̀ baaŋ a yɛŋ gɛ,
mù kintuŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ,
mù muh gɛ̀ baaŋ a kwajɛ gɛ,
mu munɛ le mù Nyo gɛ̀ seesɛ fɛ bamii ba koŋe wu le.”

content: Nyo le wu ge Kiyo ke dunyɛ mwɛɛ munɛ besabɛŋ le. Kiyo ki Nyo to ki taade mwɛɛ munchii, ki taade mo kinyilɛ ki Nyo,
nje gɛ taŋlo muh mu kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì muh mu kwaji fɛ fitele fie le fede kiyo ki mwɛdɛ kì le yi ye ye le gɛ. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no gɛ taŋlo muh kɛ̂ɛ fiɛɛ fì Nyo kwaji fede Kiyo ki Nyo gɛ.
Gɛ Kiyo ki Nyo gɛ nya besabɛŋ le nyume ki yi woŋ kfunɛ le gɛ. Kiyo kinɛ gɛ ja fɛ Nyo le, ki ge besabɛŋ kêe nya yichii yi Nyo le wu buu besabɛŋ yu.

Bee mo be feeji mwɛɛ munɛ nyume gɛ, bɛ jɛ́ yi ba yɛyi bɛ bvufee bvu muh wu wuŋ gɛ. Bee feeji nyume bɛ jɛ́ yì yɛyi Kiyo ki Yuude bee yu, bee naji mwɛɛ mù nchiɛɛŋ mu Kiyo ki Yuude, fɛ bamii ba kɛme Kiyo ki Yuude le.

Gɛ muh wù baaŋ a kɛmɛ gɛ Kiyo ki Yuude yi ye ye le gɛ, to wu fii mwɛɛ mu Kiyo ki Nyo gɛ. Wu jade fie wu tu wu yɛde lɛ le mwɛɛ mu kiyuŋ. Gɛ taŋlo wu kɛɛ no mu le gɛ, nje le mwɛɛ taŋlo ge gɛh nyume Kiyo ki Yuude fɛ muh kɛɛ.
Geenɛ, muh wù Kiyo ki Yuude le yi ye ye le taŋlo wu taa fiɛɛ fichii chuule wu kɛɛ kinyi kiyu, gɛ muh nyume yu wù taŋlo wu taa mwɛɛ mu wɛɛ muh gɛ.

content.text: “Gɛ muh nyume yu wù kee fiɛɛ fì Tada kwaji,
wu lɛ wu têfɛ Tada gɛ.”

content: Geenɛ, besabɛŋ kɛmɛ nyume baŋkwajɛ ba Kletu.
